name: chevron-line-right
description: A rounded chevron pointing right toward a separate stop line in a square frame.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner requested the Chevron V and its separate stop line to sit closer together in every frame and cardinal direction. For Line Up, larger None keeps its head x2.875..21.125 and unchanged4sqrt(2)*73/32 arm length, but moves the V and bar equally toward each other: head vertices (2.875,18.0625),(12,8.9375),(21.125,18.0625), bar (2.875,5.9375) to (21.125,5.9375). Its centerline tip-to-bar separation is3, giving1.25px visible clearance at Regular1.75 and.5px at Bold2.50. Visible bounds x2..22/y5.0625..18.9375 remain centered at12,12, with unchanged20px primary extent. Compact Square/Circle head vertices are (8,15.25),(12,11.25),(16,15.25), bar (8,8.75) to (16,8.75), preserving the existing head size and width. Compact centerline separation is2.5: visible gap.75px at Regular; Bold has intentional tangency at (12,10), without overlap. Compact Regular visible glyph size is9.75 by8.25, centered at12,12. Other directions are rigid quarter-turns about12,12. Outline stroke remains1.75 with round caps/joins. Filled is rebuilt with fixed.875 triangle expansion and a separate.875-radius capsule; no scaled stroke or runtime transform. None remains larger than compact framed glyphs. Square exterior radius6/Outline radius5.125 and all outer frame geometry are unchanged by this spacing revision; Circle remains radius10/Outline9.125. All revisions remain draft pending owner review.
